_about: Corrections to word-by-word meanings from the Quran.com API that are wrong. Keyed by surah:ayah:position. Applied in practice exercises and the Dictionary; the downloaded data in words/ is left untouched. Each entry says what the source had.

25:68:17.source: Quran.com Urdu had «وہ زندہ کرتے» (they bring to life) — a typo for زنا کرتے.
